notes: States describe DX2Ed, not T3Ed. T3Ed icon/resource presence is evidence of an authoring workflow, not proof of DX2 binary compatibility. No retail assets included.

capabilities.title: 3D viewport/camera and selection

capabilities.title: Static mesh and texture browser
capabilities.evidence: 0.4.2 DX2Ed asset catalog, searchable Assets tab, async textured GLB preview exporter, placing unused IBD meshes as undoable virtual drafts, local cache and source identity checking; DX2Ed v0.41 adds a source-backed MatLib/texture browser with nine raw stage slots, resolved-reference filters and SHA-256-verified local PNG thumbnails from user-supplied IBD/Maps ZIP files; read-only DX2Ed v0.42 connects the resolved MatLib diffuse preview to one selected private Polygon surface; v0.43 adds all-or-nothing assignment to multiple selected private Polygon brushes with one batch Undo/Redo transaction and multi-selection Save/reopen; v0.44 preserves raw texture usage codes, adds per-material raw slot-resolution counts and usage-code filters, and labels slot-0 preview assignment as an unverified candidate rather than proven shader semantics. v0.45 adds a read-only catalog-wide comparison of raw stage_mask low-nine bits against non-empty ordered slot positions, per-slot texture usage-code/name frequencies and raw category/flags distributions; results remain exploratory. DX2Ed v0.46 adds raw category_id and flags filters plus a bounded category/flags cohort report comparing low-nine mask and named-slot occupancy patterns; these numeric fields remain opaque and are not assigned semantic names. DX2Ed v0.47 adds a read-only original MOPP-linked render-section → MatLib name cross-reference using source GMP SHA, original Level triangle/block/section IDs and the observed render-material name; exact/casefold candidates and catalog duplicate caveats are explicit, with no native material index claim.
capabilities.next_step: Recover an independently authenticated source material index or render-section-to-MatLib object reference; validate against rendered output before assigning native shader semantics.

capabilities.title: Actor class palette and property browser
capabilities.evidence: DX2Ed 0.4.3 parses GameSys .d2u class declarations and observed GMP actor templates to archetypes.json. Searchable Classes tab lists declared base classes, template examples and previews. Typed scalar actor edits from 0.4.1.
capabilities.next_step: Complete typed inheritance and default property value resolution; assign validated native archetypes to new actors; build guarded GMP/IBD package writer with in-game roundtrip.

capabilities.title: Editable level project/source format
capabilities.evidence: DX2Ed persists transform/property and IBD placement designs in private JSON. DX2SDK v0.2 independently generates source-verified original GMP actors.json, and v0.1+ exposes source-SHA-bound editable multi-actor native Location plans. These are private editor/SDK project files, not native level sources or an UnrealEd/T3Ed replacement.; v0.35 full synthetic project save/reopen smoke covers rotated face-resized brush, original prop preview move and orthographic workspace.
capabilities.next_step: Unified authoring project integrating source-verified assets, placements, dialogue and script designs with reversible native writers; GMP/IBD remain authoritative for runtime

capabilities.title: Vertex, face, polygon edit
capabilities.evidence: DX2Ed v0.35 editor-only face In/Out on Box/Wall/Floor draft brushes (six local-axis faces) with anchored opposing plane, undo/redo and private JSON project round-trip; source T3Ed ModeFaceDrag reference. Native BSP face/vertex mesh authoring remains missing. v0.37: Alt+Shift viewport click selects local six-axis face of only the already-selected editor-only Box/Wall/Floor, rotation-aware, then Inspector In/Out changes dimensions; real Godot synthetic smoke. v0.38: custom concave Polygon draft brush with 3-32 editable local footprint vertices, bounded XZ coordinate UI, insertion/deletion, triangulated top/bottom and side preview mesh, Undo/Redo and strict private project save/reopen; synthetic Godot test. v0.39: selectable editor-only Polygon footprint handles and a top-plane viewport drag in Top/Perspective; world X/Z grid snapping, validated live preview, one Undo/Redo transaction and synthetic real-Godot smoke. v0.52: the original source-section Inspector adds selectable MOPP-subset Level float32 weld handles with incident edge/triangle details; these are not native BSP vertex IDs.
capabilities.next_step: General 3D polyhedral vertex/edge editing and independently authenticated native BSP/zone/CSG cooking remain missing; custom polygon tools are private Godot drafts and source weld handles are read-only MOPP-subset evidence.

capabilities.title: Material inspector and UV operations
capabilities.evidence: DX2Ed textured IBD rendering; T3Ed TexturePan/TextureRotate icons DX2Ed v0.40: custom Polygon preview mesh now has independent Top/Bottom/Sides material slots, procedural checker texture, per-slot UV scale/offset, Undo/Redo and private JSON persistence; original MatLib shader stages remain metadata-only. DX2Ed v0.41 adds source-backed read-only MatLib records, nine stage references and verified decoded texture thumbnails in a separate Materials workspace; shader semantics remain metadata-only. DX2Ed v0.42 applies a SHA-256-pinned resolved diffuse thumbnail from the Materials workspace to a selected private Polygon Top/Bottom/Sides slot; v0.43 adds one-transaction batch assignment across multiple selected private Polygon brushes, all-or-nothing mixed-selection refusal, and multi-selection private Save/reopen; unavailable/tampered cache falls back to the checker. v0.44 adds raw stage-mask/slot counts and filters by parser-decoded texture usage code while explicitly withholding shader-stage semantic claims. v0.45 adds a bounded read-only MatLib catalog audit comparing raw low-nine stage-mask bits with named slot occupancy, reporting high bits, mismatches, per-slot resource usage/name frequencies and raw category/flags counts without semantic inference. DX2Ed v0.47 carries selected original MOPP-linked render-section names into a source-hash-bound MatLib cross-reference panel, showing exact/casefold/ambiguous/no-match candidates, raw nine-slot references and a verified slot-0 thumbnail; this is name correlation only, not a native material binding.
capabilities.next_step: Decode an independently authenticated native surface/material reference and compare source-backed shader stages with rendered output; keep native assignment disabled until proven.

capabilities.title: Original source surface topology Inspector
capabilities.evidence: DX2Ed v0.48 adds bounded read-only analysis of the MOPP terminal-leaf subset for a selected original Flesh render-section tuple: exact source-weld connectivity, connected components, summed per-triangle Level-unit area/bounds/centroid, MOPP-leaf source edge-class counts, perimeter and adjacent MOPP-linked sections. The 8,192-triangle section and 1,024-incidence-per-edge caps skip atomically. This is not a complete render/BSP surface or Havok adjacency graph.
capabilities.next_step: Authenticate complete BSP surface polygons and native material indices; validate against independently rendered geometry and the retail runtime.

capabilities.title: Source-section neighbor navigation and filled MOPP subset preview
capabilities.evidence: DX2Ed v0.49 adds exact-weld MOPP-leaf adjacent-section navigation using a deterministic representative original triangle ID, plus a translucent editor-only fill overlay for the selected MOPP terminal-leaf subset. Preview is capped atomically at 8,192 triangles and uses a display-only normal offset. This is not complete Flesh/BSP topology, Havok adjacency, native collision or writable geometry.
capabilities.next_step: Authenticate complete original BSP surface polygons and native surface/material identities; compare source-section fills against independently rendered original maps.

capabilities.title: Source-section exact-weld edge topology overlay
capabilities.evidence: DX2Ed v0.50 adds bounded raw exact-original-float32-weld edge records for the authenticated MOPP terminal-leaf subset, a transient four-class viewport line overlay, and copyable JSON. Classifications are subset-open, within-section shared, cross-section MOPP-shared, and subset non-manifold; raw source edge class codes remain uninterpreted.
capabilities.next_step: Authenticate complete original Flesh/BSP polygons and native edge/material identities; compare against independently rendered source maps and retail runtime behavior.

capabilities.title: Interactive source-section edge picking and navigation
capabilities.evidence: DX2Ed v0.51 adds a camera-signature-cached, 64-pixel screen-space index for the bounded exact-original-float32-weld MOPP-leaf edge overlay; hover highlights and click selection expose weld IDs, incident Level triangle IDs, raw source edge code and a verified adjacent-section representative. The selected-edge Inspector can navigate to local or adjacent MOPP-linked triangles and copy source-pinned JSON. This remains a MOPP terminal-leaf subset, not complete native BSP edge/vertex identity.
capabilities.next_step: Authenticate complete original Flesh/BSP surface and vertex provenance, then compare edge/vertex picking against independent source-map rendering; keep native writers disabled.

capabilities.title: Interactive source-section vertex picking and navigation
capabilities.evidence: DX2Ed v0.52 derives a bounded vertex inventory from the authenticated MOPP terminal-leaf edge report, draws transient exact-original-float32-weld handles, and supports camera/clip-aware 12-pixel screen-space hover/click. The selected-vertex Inspector exposes incident edge keys, original Level triangle IDs and observed adjacent-section representatives, with local/adjacent navigation and source-pinned JSON. These are MOPP terminal-leaf subset weld identities, not native BSP vertex IDs or complete Flesh render vertices.
capabilities.next_step: Authenticate complete original Flesh/BSP vertex provenance and compare source vertex picking against independent original-map rendering; keep native writers disabled.
